mapper.select: SELECT es.id AS exam_sheet_id, es.name AS exam_sheet_name, es.total_count AS total_count, SUM(sa.is_correct) AS correct_count, MAX(sa.submitted_at) AS submitted_at FROM student_answer sa INNER JOIN exam_sheet es ON sa.exam_sheet_id = es.id WHERE sa.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY es.id, es.name, es.total_count ORDER BY submitted_at DESC

SELECT esp.problem_id AS problem_id, esp.sort_order AS sort_order, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, sa.is_correct AS is_correct FROM exam_sheet_problem esp INNER JOIN problem p ON esp.problem_id = p.id LEFT JOIN student_answer sa ON sa.problem_id = esp.problem_id AND sa.exam_sheet_id = esp.exam_sheet_id AND sa.student_id = #{studentId} WHERE esp.exam_sheet_id = #{examSheetId} ORDER BY esp.sort_order ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_answer WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND exam_sheet_id = #{examSheetId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.tag_value AS label, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(sa.is_correct) AS correct_count FROM student_answer sa INNER JOIN problem_tag pt ON sa.problem_id = pt.problem_id INNER JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.id AND t.tag_type = #{tagType} WHERE sa.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY t.id, t.tag_value, t.sort_order ORDER BY t.sort_order ASC
